narrative.overview: Realistic-looking Earth replaces the agency's alpine and botanical scenery. Near-black surroundings, light product exhibits and retained icy blue coexist within sections. The actual products remain the proof. Manrope and the user-supplied logo retain their identity.

rules.name: Shared Section Rule
rules.body: Compose light and dark elements within sections instead of alternating monochrome bands.

rules.name: Static Material Rule
rules.body: Use static tonal contrast and borders; do not restore Lenis or live SVG lens sampling.

dos: Do retain Manrope and the supplied logo's geometry and colors.
Do preserve product palettes and demonstration boundaries.
Do keep navigation at one safe-area-aware vertical position.
Do separate browser observations from hardware performance claims.
donts: Don't restore nature imagery as the agency environment.
Don't promise measured FPS or Safari/device verification without evidence.
